_comment: OP25 config for Docker/headless Icecast deployment.
_comment2: Edit devices[], trunking.chans[], and metadata.streams[] for your system.
_comment3: Audio goes to liquidsoap via UDP, so the 'audio' section is intentionally absent.
_layout: All files referenced below (tgid-tags.tsv, rid-tags.tsv, blacklist files, key files) must live in the same directory as this cfg.json and be mounted to /config inside the container. All paths are relative to /config.

channels.name: Channel 0
channels._comment: UDP port must match the AUDIO_PORT env var (default 23456). liquidsoap reads from this port.
channels._comment_filters: blacklist/whitelist can be a filename (relative to /config) or a comma-separated list of TGIDs.
channels._comment_crypt: 0=allow encrypted audio through, 1=silence encrypted calls, 2=skip encrypted calls entirely.
channels._comment_keys: Path to a JSON key file, relative to /config. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for key file format.

devices._comment: args: 'rtl' for RTL-SDR, 'airspy' for Airspy, 'uhd' for USRP, 'hackrf' for HackRF.
devices._comment_gains: LNA gain 0-49 dB for RTL-SDR. Tune this to avoid overload or noise floor.
devices.name: sdr0
devices._comment_ppm: Frequency error correction in parts-per-million. Use kalibrate-rtl or a known signal to measure.

chans._comment_nac: Network Access Code. Set to '0x0' to auto-detect, or the actual NAC hex value for your system.
chans._comment_cc: Comma-separated list of known control channel frequencies in MHz. OP25 will hunt between these if one drops.
chans._comment_tgid: Relative path to talkgroup tags file inside /config. See tgid-tags.tsv for format.
chans._comment_rid: Optional: relative path to radio ID tags file inside /config. Remove this line to disable.
chans._comment_filters: Per-system blacklist/whitelist — filename (relative to /config) or comma-separated TGIDs.
chans._comment_tdma: Set to true only if the control channel itself is a TDMA (Phase 2) channel.

streams._comment: stream_name is empty string to match the default (unnamed) channel. Must match your liquidsoap mount.
streams._comment2: Icecast server running inside the container. Port must match ICECAST_PORT env var.
streams._comment3: Mount name must match ICECAST_MOUNT env var. Extension tells clients how to request the stream.

_comment_audio: No 'audio' section here. liquidsoap owns the UDP:23456 audio socket and streams directly to Icecast. Adding an 'audio' section would start sockaudio.py and cause a port conflict.

terminal._comment: Bind to 0.0.0.0 so the web UI is reachable from outside the container on port 8080.
terminal._comment_colors: Keywords are matched case-insensitively against the talkgroup tag from tgid-tags.tsv. First match wins.
